issues.description: Basic usage example uses next() over pipeline.nodes, relying on undocumented iteration order.
issues.detail: `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is brittle: it teaches a bad habit and silently breaks in multi-node pipelines where Pipeline ordering is topological, not insertion-based. Replace with `pipeline.nodes[0]` (with a note on ordering) or a name-based lookup like `name=='train_model_node'`.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after return.
issues.detail: An unconditional `return ImagePreview(...)` is followed by a commented-out data-URI alternative presented as a live second option. The snippet is syntactically dead and misleading. Split into two functions or use an if/else with a parameter so both branches actually parse as intent.

issues.description: preview_fn contract and time semantics are never stated up front.
issues.detail: The doc never defines preview_fn's signature, arity, return-type invariant, lazy invocation, error propagation, or when the preview reflects (last run, hypothetical, illustration). Readers must induce the contract from examples. A short paragraph before Basic Usage stating the contract would make the rest of the document follow by deduction.

issues.description: Closure workaround for data context captures stale construction-time data and is not reconciled with the no-input/output caveat.
issues.detail: The doc asserts previews cannot access node inputs/outputs, then teaches closure capture of a `sample_data` literal frozen at pipeline construction — not run-time data. Either show DataCatalog access inside the closure, mark run-time access as out of scope, or revisit whether preview_fn belongs on the node at all rather than as a (inputs, outputs) function.

issues.description: Bare node(...) calls and ellipsis literals make several snippets non-runnable as written.
issues.detail: Top-level `node(func=..., preview_fn=...)` calls dangle outside any Pipeline, and CustomPreview uses `'nodes': [...]` / `'edges': [...]` ellipsis placeholders that execute but produce nothing usable. Wrap node calls in a Pipeline (or annotate `# inside Pipeline([...])`) and show one minimal real node/edge, or clearly label as pseudocode.

issues.description: Lowercase 'polars' added to Vale ignore list duplicating existing 'Polars' entry.
issues.detail: The ignore list now contains both `Polars` and `polars`, suggesting prose lowercased a proper noun. Either normalise to the capitalised brand name in prose and drop the lowercase entry, or make the Vale rule case-insensitive. Bolting a second entry on for one doc creates style-config drift.

synthesis.summary: Docs-only PR introducing the experimental preview_fn API. The panel agrees the writing is competent and type coverage reasonable, but examples are sloppy in ways that will mislead anyone copying them: dead code after returns, `next()` over `pipeline.nodes`, ellipsis placeholders, and bare node() calls outside any Pipeline. The preview_fn contract (signature, lazy invocation, time semantics) is never stated up front, and the closure-based workaround for data context captures stale construction-time data while contradicting the no-input/output caveat. Fix the broken examples, define the contract in one paragraph, and reconcile the data-context guidance before merge.
